institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Traffic congestion caused by poor lane discipline and heterogeneous traffic conditions
description: CoSiCoSt-Env is a composite signal control strategy that optimizes signal timing using weighted combinations of delays and stop counts. The system is designed for Indian traffic conditions and supports real-time traffic management in highly heterogeneous environments.
applications:
Smart city and intelligent transportation system (ITS) projects
Urban local bodies, municipal corporations, and traffic management authorities
Traffic signal equipment manufacturers and system integrators
Transportation planning, mobility, and infrastructure consulting firms
Government agencies implementing smart mobility and congestion management solutions
